sentences.text: FDA first posted the sterile water shortage on 2021-11-23 and it remains Current as of 2026-10-21.
Our product label names Nephron SC, LLC (FEI 3010892830) as the manufacturing plant.
FDA inspection 1167490 at that plant ended 2022-04-20 and was classified OAI with observations including validation lacking for sterile drug products.
That OAI classification occurred 148 days after the shortage posting.
Subsequent inspections in 2023-02-10, 2024-02-09, and 2024-09-25 were also classified OAI.
The rule‑selected option is to buy from Chartwell RX, LLC, which is not on FDA's shortage list today.

rejected.text: Two Class II recalls by Nephron Sc Inc for CGMP deviations and potential product carryover were initiated in 2023-01-12 and 2023-02-23.
rejected.reason: "Two" is a number in words; numbers must be digits from the evidence

memory.text: Decision on lidocaine: switch lidocaine 1% 30 mL vials to 5 mL vials in the ED to reduce waste during the shortage. Rationale: Single-dose waste was a third of use (demo history). Approved by Alex Morgan, PharmD.

Decision on cisplatin: transfer cisplatin between Corvale hospitals weekly instead of buying grey-market stock. Rationale: Grey-market offers were 6 to 10 times contract price with unverifiable pedigree (demo history). Approved by Jordan Hale, PharmD.

Q-0bc468.sql: SELECT inspection_id, fei, end_date, cfr, short_description FROM fda.citations WHERE inspection_id IN ('731152', '868313', '938418', '1167490', '1168119', '1197994', '1229051', '1247772') ORDER BY inspection_id, cfr

Q-905088.sql: SELECT a.ndc11 AS ndc11, a.generic_name AS item, b.ndc11 AS alt_ndc11, b.generic_name AS alternative, b.strength AS alt_strength, ti.rule, ti.approved_by, ti.approved_on, ti.notes, p.labeler_name AS alt_labeler FROM corvale_general.therapeutic_interchange ti JOIN corvale_general.formulary_item a ON a.item_id = ti.item_id JOIN corvale_general.formulary_item b ON b.item_id = ti.alt_item_id LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p ON p.ndc11 = b.ndc11 WHERE a.ndc11 IN ('00487610501')
